_: Pulse configuration. Copy to ops/pulse.config.json and fill in what your app has. A blank value turns that reader OFF and the page says 'not configured' for it, never a zero. App identity (App Store id, Android package, repo, product name, site, mention terms, Play reports bucket) falls back to tools/app_config.py when blank here. Credentials never go in this file: they are environment variables (see .github/workflows/pulse.yml).

product._repo: owner/Repo on GitHub; stars, traffic, issues, and the deploy that ships the web row.
product._ownerLogins: GitHub logins whose issues are OURS; everyone else's are 'from outside'.
product._deployWorkflow: e.g. deploy-pages.yml. The web store row's version is its newest successful run, read rather than typed.

apple._appStoreId: The numeric id in the App Store URL. It is also the ASC app id, and the sales report is filtered by it: the report covers the whole VENDOR account.

play._stackMarker: A substring that only YOUR frames carry in a Java stack (your package, e.g. 'com.example.app'). The crash drawer shows the first such line.

amazon._package: The Fire TV package (often the same as play.package). Blank = the Amazon readers are off. AMAZON_APP_ID (the devportal id) is an env secret.

roku._consoleUrl: Your channel's analytics page in the Roku Developer Dashboard (link only).

mentions._strict: Terms that on their own mean US: your domain, a one-word product name.
mentions._loose: A product name that is also ordinary words. It counts only beside a corroborating word.
mentions._query: One search string for Reddit, Hacker News, Lemmy and Google News. Blank = those readers are off.

social._ledger: Optional: a posting programme's ledger and its measured engagement. Absent files = the Program readers say so.

web._counterOrigin: Your privacy-first counter (pulse/worker-example). Blank = web usage and tallies are off. Env PULSE_COUNTER overrides.
web._ingestOrigin: The vendor drop box (same Worker). Roku's Looker schedule POSTs to <origin>/ingest/roku?t=<PULSE_INGEST_TOKEN>.
web._tallies: Anonymous day|kind|count tallies your server already keeps to PROVIDE a feature. Each: {"name": "rooms", "label": "Rooms opened", "path": "/tally-daily?name=rooms", "kinds": ["room", "guest"]}. Never a client-sent count.

search._site: The Search Console property exactly as registered: 'https://example.com/' (trailing slash) or 'sc-domain:example.com'.
search._pagePattern: A regex over sitemap URLs for the pages you want indexed, e.g. '/(item|series)/'. Blank = search_index is off.

cloudUsage._project: A Google Cloud project whose API usage IS a product signal (e.g. the OAuth client's project). Reads are billed to it via x-goog-user-project.
cloudUsage._events: Name -> method suffix counted on 2xx, e.g. {"broadcasts": "LiveBroadcastService.Insert"}.
